chants.vernacular_text: The Lord is the strength of his people, and the guardian of salvation for his Anointed. Save your people, O Lord, and bless your inheritance; be their guide for ever. ℣. Unto you, O Lord, will I cry; O my God, be not silent with me; if you remain silent, I will become like those who go down into the grave.
Turn back, O Lord, ever so slightly, we beseech you, and consent to be entreated by your servants. ℣. O Lord, you have been unto us a refuge, from age to age.
In you, Lord, do I trust, let me never be put to shame; in your righteousness deliver me and rescue me; lend me your ear and make haste to save me.
Render secure my footsteps in your paths so that my feet do not slip; incline your ear and hear my words; display your wonderful mercies O Lord, Saviour of those who place their hope in you.
"That which I tell you in the dark, utter in the light", says the Lord; "and that which you hear whispered into your ear, proclaim upon the housetops".
I shall walk round about his sanctuary, offering a sacrifice of jubilation; I will sing and recite a psalm to the Lord.
If a man wishes to come after me, let him deny himself and take up his cross and follow me.
